highlights.title: Dominant, and it didn't matter
highlights.text: Zach went 13-1 in the regular season and posted the week's high score 7 out of 14 weeks — half the entire season — yet didn't win the championship. The most lopsided regular-season vs. actual-outcome gap of any year on record.

highlights.title: Quiet champion
highlights.text: Brian won the actual title with a modest 7-7 record and just 2 weekly high scores — proof that peaking in the playoffs beats dominating the regular season.

highlights.title: No power ranking exists for this year
highlights.text: Roster strength and playoff odds were never tracked for 2023, so there's no power-rank formula to apply here — the list above is sorted by actual win-loss record only.
